summary: Easy top five, then surprises: Italy, Hong Kong and Taiwan are in, the UK, France and Japan are not. Plays even better as a Blitz, where every country scores.
reasons: Casual found 5 (US, China, Russia, India, Germany) and ran out of lives in 10 guesses on UK #11, Japan #19, Saudi Arabia #29, France #13 and Switzerland #17: fair near misses, but the classic is short and harsh.
Fan went 10/10 losing 2; Hong Kong and Taiwan counted as separate entries (Forbes convention) are the stretch answers.
Blitz: all 31 casual names scored and bigger answers pay more, so it suits Blitz better than the classic.
fixes: Drop alias 'Zhongguo' from Taiwan (it means China); typing it now offers China or Taiwan.
